summary: Troubleshoot SSL/TLS by checking reachability and the chain with true | openssl s_client -showcerts -connect host:port, inspecting certificates with openssl x509 -in cert -noout -text (subject, issuer, validity), and verifying the CA with openssl verify -CAfile ca.pem server.pem (OK means valid).
questions: How do I troubleshoot SSL certificate issues in AAP?
How do I view a server's certificate chain with openssl?
How do I verify a certificate was signed by a trusted CA?

answer_card.title: Check TLS certificates
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
# reachability and full chain
true | openssl s_client -showcerts -connect <fqdn_or_ip>:<port>
# certificate details (subject, issuer, validity)
openssl x509 -in <path_to_certificate> -noout -text
# signed by trusted CA? (prints OK)
openssl verify -CAfile <ca_cert> <server_cert>
```
